message: Maria — I'm confirming Millfield Community Center as the venue for your listening session this week. I'll handle logistics: seating, room setup, outreach to my drop-in regulars, retraining program enrollees, and anyone who's come through our doors since tick 0. Ninety minutes. Folding chairs. I will NOT manage the agenda — that's yours. What I can add: I'll have the one-page resource document ready for every attendee — the $2,500 grant info, David Chen's bank contact for small-dollar loans, and the MCC enrollment timeline. That came directly out of our tick 5 work. Every person leaves with something concrete. Let me know if you need anything from me before then. I'll be there.

resource_transfer.in_kind: venue, logistics coordination, resource document distribution, community network outreach

expected_outcome: public listening session successfully hosted; retraining resource document in the hands of displaced workers and business owners; Maria Santos's task force work amplified through community center infrastructure
